decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter builds directly on the firm's core track-system know-how and was presented as a flagship, so the firm can interpret its results and keep refining it in-house.

The LED luminaire line sits close to the firm's established lighting competence, but the fast LED product cycles since 2018 make replacement by newer models fairly likely, so it is kept with moderate risk.

The home automation server box is further from the firm's core lighting knowledge, which makes it harder to learn from and improve, yet it still supports the firm's control and automation strategy and is retained for now.
The luminaire family rests on the firm's core design and engineering knowledge, and its dedicated page shows it was positioned as a lasting product line.
